court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, Nagpur vide Petition-A No.1174/2019
case_name: Sau. Kavita Krunal Gawande vs Krunal S/O Jitnish Gawande
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The parties are married and the wife filed an application under Section 12 of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act for grant of maintenance, right of residence and protection. The trial court granted maintenance to the wife. The husband has preferred an appeal against this order.

legal_principles.principle: Wife's convenience must be considered in matrimonial proceedings, particularly when the husband has filed a petition against her.
legal_principles.held: The Hon'ble Apex Court in the matter of Sumita Singh V/s Kumar Sanjay & Anr. Reported in AIR 2002 SC 396 has observed that wife's convenience must be considered in matrimonial proceedings, particularly when the husband has filed the petition against her.
cited_cases: Sumita Singh V/s Kumar Sanjay & Anr., (2002) AIR 2002 SC 396

outcome.final_order: The court transferred the matrimonial proceedings pending on the file of Family Court, Nagpur to the file of Family Court, Chandrapur or Civil Judge Senior Division, Chandrapur.
